name: Common Goldstar
desc: Common Goldstar (Hypoxis hirsuta): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 32 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Hypoxis hirsuta, commonly known as common goldstar, common star-grass, eastern yellow stargrass, yellow star grass, or yellow star flower, is a perennial ornamental plant in the family Hypoxidaceae.
